source: Stardew Valley Wiki (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0): Bundles and Remixed Bundles, cross-checked against Modding:Bundles raw data, the rendered Remixed Bundles page and every item page
notes: Bundles that do not specify quality will accept items of any quality.
For bundles that do specify a quality, a better quality is also acceptable.

A few bundles display more items than there are slots to fill (e.g., Artisan Bundle: 12 items, 6 slots to fill). In this case, the player can choose which of the shown items they want to use to fill the bundle. They do not have to use all shown items, only enough to fill the slots.
A room can have a mix of permanent and random bundles.

Modding:Bundles raw data is from game version 1.5.1; The Community Center fish tank now becomes an actual Fish Tank when the Fish Tank bundles are completed. The River Fish Bundle now rewards Deluxe Bait instead of Bait. The Night Fish Bundle now rewards Glow Ring instead of Small Glow Ring.

fields.slots: how many of the listed items must be put in (e.g. 4 of 6)
fields.group: items with the same group number in one bundle are alternatives: the game picks one of them when the save is created
fields.random_items: remixed: this many of the listed items are picked when the save is created
fields.remix: remixed: the game picks `pick` of the `of` bundles that share `group`; null = always present
fields.quality: minimum quality; better quality is accepted
fields.seasons: seasons the item can be found or grown (null = not seasonal)

rooms.name: Crafts Room
rooms.unlock: The Crafts Room contains the first group of bundles available.
rooms.effect: Completing all Crafts Room bundles repairs the bridge east of The Mines, unlocking the Quarry.

rooms.name: Pantry
rooms.unlock: The Pantry appears after completing one bundle.
rooms.effect: Completing all Pantry bundles will restore the dilapidated Greenhouse on the farm, making it available to grow Crops, Fruit Trees, and Trees year-round.

rooms.name: Fish Tank
rooms.unlock: The Fish Tank appears after completing one bundle.
rooms.effect: Completing all Fish Tank bundles will remove the Glittering Boulder to the left of The Mines entrance.

rooms.name: Boiler Room
rooms.unlock: The Boiler Room appears after completing two bundles.
rooms.effect: Completing all Boiler Room bundles repairs the Minecarts, allowing the player to fast travel between distant locations.

rooms.name: Bulletin Board
rooms.unlock: The Bulletin Board appears after completing three bundles.
rooms.effect: Completing all Bulletin Board bundles improves the player's friendship rating with every non-datable villager by two hearts (500 points).

rooms.name: Vault
rooms.unlock: The Vault becomes available after completing four bundles.
rooms.effect: Completing all Vault bundles costs 42500g, and repairs the Bus Stop.

rooms.name: Abandoned JojaMart
rooms.unlock: After completing the Community Center, the first night before a rainy or stormy day, a cutscene will trigger in which a bolt of lightning strikes the abandoned JojaMart, opening its doors.
